verses.greek: καὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ πολλοὶ ἵνα σιωπήσῃ· ὁ δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν· Υἱὲ Δαυίδ, ἐλέησόν με.
verses.literal: And were rebuking him many that he may be silent. the but much more he was crying out Son of David do have mercy on me.
verses.dgt: And many were rebuking him so that he would be silent, but he cried out much more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

verses.greek: καὶ στὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Φωνήσατε αὐτόν. καὶ φωνοῦσι τὸν τυφλὸν λέγοντες αὐτῷ· Θάρσει, ἔγειρε, φωνεῖ σε.
verses.literal: And having stopped the Jesus commanded: do call him. And they call the blind man saying to him take courage! do rise up He calls you.
verses.dgt: And stopping, Jesus said, “Call him.” And they call the blind man, saying to him, “Take courage! Get up; he is calling you.”

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ ἀποβαλὼν τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ ἀναπηδήσας ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.
verses.literal: the And having cast away the cloak of him having jumped up he came to the Jesus.
verses.dgt: And throwing off his cloak, he jumped up and came to Jesus.

verses.greek: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Τί σοι θέλεις ποιήσω; ὁ δὲ τυφλὸς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ραββουνι, ἵνα ἀναβλέψω.
verses.literal: And answering to him the Jesus said What to you do you desire I may do the And the blind man said to Him Rabboni that I may receive sight.
verses.dgt: And answering him, Jesus said, “What do you want me to do for you?” And the blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

verses.greek: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ὕπαγε, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε. καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέβλεψεν, καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.
verses.literal: And the Jesus said to him do go the faith of you has healed you. And immediately he received sight and he was following Him on the way.
verses.dgt: And Jesus said to him, “Go; your faith has saved you.” And immediately he saw again and was following him on the road.
